title: Bind live-region assertions to each transcript element
trigger: Remove aria-live from both transcript elements while other live regions remain.
impact: Accessibility proof still reports PASS, permitting loss of announced conversation/room updates to escape this regression gate. Current candidate attributes are present; no current UI failure is asserted.
proof: tests-accessibility-negative-repro.json: isolated exact candidate copy with two attribute removals exits0 and prints accessibility/responsive proof PASS. Regex crosses tags via [\s\S]*.
remediation: Parse actual element attributes or query both transcript nodes in DOM; include a negative case removing each attribute independently.
acceptance_refs: supplemental WP-18C.07a accessibility/responsive proof; not a new core denominator

title: Assert cancellation completes before the probe timeout
trigger: A recovery regression ignores cancellation during a pending probe and observes shutdown only after its 600-second timeout.
impact: Paused Tokio time automatically advances; the test can pass after 600 virtual seconds and cannot prove its stated prompt-shutdown invariant. Current production select has cancellation; no present 600s production delay is asserted.
proof: tests-virtual-time-repro/result.json: 1 test passes while explicitly measuring 600 seconds. Isolated counterexample using pinned Tokio 1.49, original yield/cancel/await oracle; not a mutation of the production crate.
remediation: Measure tokio::time::Instant around cancellation and assert a small virtual-time bound, or wrap JoinHandle in a timeout far shorter than 600s. Prove mutation removing cancellation fails.

title: Three independent Cargo graphs still lack change-triggered CI ownership
trigger: A PR changes only adl-characterization/**, adl-resilience/**, or tools/remote_validation/**.
impact: No selected package-local build/test/format/Clippy owner; required CI may remain green without testing changed graph. adl-resilience as another crate dependency does not execute its own package tests.
proof: Fresh frozen selector runs for each root in tests-history/syn006-routing.json: exit 0, aggregate_status skipped, lanes {}, pr_publication_sufficient false. ci.yaml manifest commands omit all three; fallback policy 1690–1788 omits them. Original historical P1 docs/reviews/v0.92/internal-review-5846/SYNTHESIS.md:69–77.
remediation: Add explicit selector and CI owners with locked package-local validation and positive path-routing regression cases for each root.

title: Reject unknown base-blob identities before asserting same-model comparison
trigger: Ollama /api/show omits modelfile or returns a FROM expression that does not match the Unix sha256 path regex for both variants.
impact: Both base_blob_sha256 values become null and compare equal; the report then unconditionally declares same_base_blob=true. Missing weight identity is promoted to proof, allowing a speculative benchmark to claim a controlled same-weight comparison without observing it. No claim that the retained #905 run used differing weights.
proof: tests-905-identity-negative.json: unmodified AST-extracted model_identity evaluated offline with two different FROM aliases and manifest digests; both null blob IDs pass every model-identity equality field. Source lines 133-144 permit null, 347-354 admit it, 427 emits true.
remediation: Require two nonempty valid base-blob digests before equality; reject unsupported metadata with an explicit non-proving outcome. Add missing/malformed FROM negative cases.

title: Reader concurrency test can fail solely because the writer finishes first
trigger: The scheduler runs the writer through all twelve commits before the parent reaches its first while-condition, or permits the reader only Busy observations until the writer finishes.
impact: The final observed > 0 assertion fails even when every commit and observation is coherent, making a purported deterministic local gate scheduler-dependent.
evidence: The writer has no handshake with the reader; the parent reads only while !writer.is_finished() and then requires at least one successful Current observation. Joining the writer and checking final generation does not guarantee any loop iteration.
reproduction: Static schedule analysis of lines 2777-2831; no executable reproduction or test execution performed.
acceptance_relevance: Reliability of required deterministic semantic Gate A validation; not evidence of production state corruption.
recommendation: Coordinate at least one reader observation with the writer using an explicit handshake, then assert coherent observations and final generation without depending on scheduler fairness.
